messages:
Ravi Kumar: Quick sync - SIX (system integrator) asked if we can accept both per-call events and appliance-level GB totals from their HW partner in APAC. They want hourly billing rollups + raw replay for audit.
Amanda Lee: Got it. Main ask: two ingestion modes. Need SKU normalization and entitlement id mapping. Also timezone normalization. :thinking_face:
Jules Park: For webhooks we need idempotency + fast ACK. Proposal: return 202 immediately with X-Relay-Id header, then async process. Prefer they send X-Event-Id.
Ravi Kumar: Can they send aggregated payloads that look like:```json
{"sku":"RED-APAC-GPU-1","entitlement_id":"ent-123","window_start":"2025-06-01T02:00:00+08:00","unit":"gigabytes","amount":1200,"event_id":"siX-20250601-0001"}
```
Amanda Lee: Perfect example. Also request a per-device fingerprint for dedupe when they send both per-call and hourly aggregates.
Marcus G: Rounding question: when they send per-GB decimals vs our per-token model, finance wants rules. Suggest: store raw amounts as decimals and apply billing rounding at invoice time with rule set.
Jules Park: Implementation notes:
- Require X-Event-Id and X-Signature (HMAC SHA256)
- Accept `unit` values from agreed enum: ["tokens","requests","gigabytes","minutes"]
- Normalise timestamps to UTC on ingest
- If `window_end - window_start` > 1h => reject (we want hourly or minute windows)

Also, backpressure: if queue length > 10k return 429 with `Retry-After` header.
Amanda Lee: Ops ask: we'll create a contract doc and test harness. Need sample replay endpoint and a sample S3 drop for bulk backfills.
Ravi Kumar: SI asks about entitlement mapping when customer migrates from hosted to private. We need to keep persistent external_entitlement_id and map to internal entitlement. Add `external_entitlement_id` optional field.
marketplace-bot: Runbook added: https://kb.redwood/marketplace/webhook-contracts (uploaded by Amanda)
Marcus G: For reconciliation: daily ledger job should compare aggregated invoiced units vs partner-reported units and surface diffs > 0.5% as tickets.
Amanda Lee: Action items:
- @Jules create webhook validator lambda + HMAC check (due EOD Thu)
- @Ravi coordinate entitlement mapping template with SIX (due next Tue)
- @Marcus draft rounding playbook and tolerance thresholds (due next Fri)
- @partnerships set partner test window Wed 00:00-02:00 PT
Ravi Kumar: Thanks all. Shared sample payload + schema in the contract PR. Will post link when ready. :thumbsup:
